product_description: Purchasing our loving moments nursing sports bra should be your first step to getting back your pre-baby shape! every new mom knows how difficult squeezing in a workout can be. With a stylish racerback design that brings added support in cute and sporty colors, and with our great breastfeeding features, fitting workouts into your breastfeeding schedule has never been easier! cotton inner slings and easy one-hand nursing clasps make breastfeeding or double breast pumping on-the-go a snap. Our cups are cotton lined, keeping you dry and comfortable throughout your activities. Perfect for simple at-home workouts, power walking with your stroller, or low to medium impact activities, wearing our loving moments nursing sports bra will encourage you to lose that baby pooch and get back into your active lifestyle
customer_review_summary: Customers find the nursing bra comfortable, supportive, and cute in style, with good functionality that works well with tanks. The bra provides adequate coverage with padding that prevents visible nursing pads, and customers appreciate its ease of use, with one noting it's a breeze to clasp in and out of. While many find the medium size great, some mention it runs a little large, and while some say it's perfect for all-day wear, others note it's not suitable for working out.
